items.name: vanafish
items.description: The Vanadreams fishing bot. Casts, reads the bite, decides catch or release by your rules, ends the fight the way the server judges it, stops itself when something is off. Vanadreams only.

items.name: charcapture
items.description: Snapshots your character for porting to Vanadreams: /capture in game, then send it from the launcher's Capture page. Reads only.

items.name: distance
items.description: Shows the distance to your target.

items.name: fps
items.description: Frame rate display and cap.

items.name: timestamp
items.description: Timestamps in the chat log.

items.name: tparty
items.description: Shows party members' TP and target HP.

items.name: recast
items.description: Ability and spell recast timers.

items.name: chatmon
items.description: Sounds and alerts for tells and chat.

items.name: itemwatch
items.description: Watch counts of items and key items on screen.

items.name: blumon
items.description: Blue Mage spell learning monitor.

items.name: blusets
items.description: Save and set Blue Mage spell sets.

v3.name: blusets
v3.note: v3 sets were JSON; v4 wants one spell per line in config\addons\blusets\<name>.txt.

items.name: checker
items.description: Shows level and evasion/defense on /check.

items.name: craftmon
items.description: Crafting results monitor.

items.name: filterless
items.description: Removes chat filters.

items.name: filterscan
items.description: Filters wide scan results.

items.name: links
items.description: Makes links in chat clickable.

items.name: mapdot
items.description: Shows your position on the map as a dot.

items.name: paranormal
items.description: Shows hidden nearby entities.

items.name: petinfo
items.description: Pet HP, MP and TP display.

items.name: repeater
items.description: Repeats a command on a timer.

items.name: affinity
items.description: Sets the game's CPU affinity.

v3.name: Affinity
v3.note: Was a plugin in v3; an addon in v4. Re-add /affinity set <mask> under the wait if you used one.

items.name: nokb
items.description: Disables knockback on you.

v3.name: No-ckback
v3.note: Was the No-ckback plugin in v3.

items.name: thirdparty
items.description: Lets outside programs talk to Ashita, the way WindowerInput did.

v3.name: WindowerInput
v3.note: Replaces WindowerInput.

items.name: screenshot
items.description: Screenshots with the chat log hidden.

items.name: minimap
items.description: A minimap overlay.

items.name: find
items.description: Finds an item across your bags, storage and slips.

items.name: Oseem
items.description: Augment tracking and control, all in its own window.

v3.name: Oseem
v3.note: Was a plugin in v3; an addon in v4 with no config files.

items.name: Lootwhore
items.description: Lots and passes the treasure pool by your rules.

v3.name: Lootwhore
v3.note: Profiles copied to config\lootwhore\profiles; check the drop and store lists once.

items.name: Bellhop
items.description: Moves items between bags and storage with one command.

v3.name: Bellhop
v3.note: Commands are /bh now; the legacy command names are switched back on for you.

items.name: Packer
items.description: Pulls the gear your sets need out of storage.

v3.name: DressMe
v3.note: Does what DressMe did; DressMe has no v4 version.

items.name: LegacyAC
items.description: Ashitacast for v4, reading your v3 gear XMLs as they are.

v3.name: Ashitacast
v3.note: Your Ashitacast XMLs were copied into config\LegacyAC. Commands are /la instead of /ac.

items.name: Multisend
items.description: Sends commands to your other characters.

v3.name: MultiSend
v3.note: Same groups file as v3, copied over.

items.name: FindAll
items.description: Searches every character's inventory at once: /fa search <item>.

v3.name: findall
v3.note: The v3 addon became this plugin. It rebuilds its own cache once each character has loaded.

items.name: XIPivot
items.description: Loads DAT overlays (HD textures, UI mods) without touching the game files.

v3.name: XIPivot
v3.note: Overlays moved from plugins\DATs to polplugins\DATs and the overlay list rewritten as config\pivot\pivot.ini. Enabled in the boot profile, not the script.

v3.name: Crafty
v3.note: No v4 version exists.

v3.name: DressMe
v3.note: No v4 version; Packer does the job.

v3.name: WatchEXP
v3.note: No v4 version exists.

v3.name: lotomatic
v3.note: No v4 version; Lootwhore covers lotting and passing.

v3.name: pbar
v3.note: No v4 version; petinfo is the nearest bundled pet display.

v3.name: pupatt
v3.note: No v4 version; Sippius's pupsets sets attachments from a file.

v3.name: status
v3.note: No v4 version exists.

v3.name: synplicity
v3.note: No v4 version exists.
